========== runbooks/INDEX.md ==========

# Feature runbook index

All runbooks inherit [Agent instructions](../AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS.md), [Operating manual](../MANUAL.md), and [Verification](../VERIFICATION.md). Procedures after a connection/generation/publication gate are conditional operating instructions, not claims of execution.

| Feature | Route | Primary use |
|---|---|---|
| [Home and AI operator](home.md) | `/home` | Use for planning, explaining the account and initiating a clearly scoped task. |
| [Profile, settings and notifications](settings.md) | `/settings` | Use during onboarding, contact changes and preference maintenance. |
| [Provider and CRM integrations](integrations.md) | `/settings?tab=integrations` | Use before any channel-specific launch, sync, reporting or delivery. |
| [Plans, quotas and billing](billing.md) | `/settings?tab=billing` | Use before batching work or evaluating service capacity. |

========== runbooks/billing.md ==========

# Plans, quotas and billing

**Route:** `/settings?tab=billing` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/settings?tab=billing)

**When:** Use before batching work or evaluating service capacity.

**Prerequisites:** Read-only account access; separate explicit authority for financial changes.

## Agent procedure

1. Read plan level and billing status separately.
2. Check AI credits, Studio usage, intent quota, active campaigns, landing pages, social pages and coaching caps.
3. Store each reset date; do not combine unlike meters.
4. Estimate planned usage against the relevant allowance and approved spending ceiling.
5. Preserve drafts on exhaustion; use a top-up or plan switch only if authorized.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The resource plan fits current entitlements and authorized costs.

Checkout, top-up, cancel, resume and plan-switch operations have financial effects. Partner and customer pricing differ.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/blog.md ==========

# SEO Blog Engine

**Route:** `/blog` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/blog)

**When:** Use for source-backed organic content and an approved business blog.

**Prerequisites:** Approved topic, sources, brand voice and publishing destination.

## Agent procedure

1. Choose a primary topic/keyword or request topic suggestions.
2. Generate one article and record the post ID.
3. Review claims, links, metadata, FAQ schema and quotations; edit to match client evidence.
4. Preview and publish only the approved version to the intended blog.
5. Verify served URL and content; use unpublish when an authorized rollback is needed.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The published article is accurate, correctly branded and reachable at the expected URL.

AI readiness and SEO scores are heuristics. Publishing and unpublishing are external actions.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/brand.md ==========

# Brand Kit

**Route:** `/settings?tab=brand-kit` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/settings?tab=brand-kit)

**When:** Use before generating visual assets or after an approved rebrand.

**Prerequisites:** Approved logo, colors, font and style direction.

## Agent procedure

1. Open Brand Kit; select the approved logo from the asset library.
2. Set primary, secondary and accent/background colors.
3. Select the brand font and describe visual style, desired subjects and exclusions.
4. Save Brand Kit, reload and confirm the values.
5. Check the next generated asset actually follows the brand.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Saved brand settings and inspected output match the approved identity.

Applying a brand does not verify facts or rights in generated assets.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/campaigns.md ==========

# Ad campaigns and optimization

**Route:** `/campaigns` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/campaigns)

**When:** Use to prepare, manage and optimize approved advertising.

**Prerequisites:** Complete client record, provider readiness, approved budget/optimization limits and verified conversion path.

## Agent procedure

1. Open New Campaign; use guided setup or the manual builder.
2. Choose platform, objective, name, lead method and destination.
3. Configure audience or Google keywords and explicit geography.
4. Set monthly budget and authorized optimization settings; inspect derived daily budget.
5. Review creative assets, copy variants, forms/privacy, tracking and nurture.
6. Save a local draft and read it back; choose paused provider creation or live launch only within authorization.
7. Poll the existing campaign/job and verify provider IDs, state and delivery before reporting success.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Draft read-back or provider state matches the chosen action; spend and conversion events match the client.

Local drafts are Tested. Live launch, pause, reallocation and autonomous optimization are not production-certified. Scores and simulations are not actual outcomes.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/coach.md ==========

# AI Sales Coach

**Route:** `/sales-coach` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/sales-coach)

**When:** Use before, during and after authorized sales calls.

**Prerequisites:** Approved playbook, accurate prospect context, available seat/call/minute quota and recording process.

## Agent procedure

1. Select the appropriate playbook and prepare prospect/company/pain/goal/objections.
2. Generate prep and check that advice fits the offer.
3. For Live, arm only when the agreed recording process permits; verify microphone capture.
4. For Review, paste transcript or upload authorized audio and inspect analysis.
5. Review drafted follow-up before any send; reconcile usage and maintain session history.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Useful coaching is grounded in the actual call, and usage/session records are verified.

UI exposes 10 analyses / 300 minutes in this plan, plus one seat. Live microphone capture and analysis were not run.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/competitors.md ==========

# Competitor Tracking

**Route:** `/competitors` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/competitors)

**When:** Use to track relevant public competitor activity and inform approved tests.

**Prerequisites:** Correct competitors, official sites and a defined comparison question.

## Agent procedure

1. Add a competitor or review AI suggestions.
2. Verify company name and website before saving.
3. Run analysis and inspect cited/current evidence.
4. Separate observation from inference and unsupported positioning claims.
5. Use findings to prepare an approved test and record source date.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Competitive claims are supported by the right company/source and date.

Analysis can be incomplete or stale. Do not copy unsupported statistics into outreach.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/creative.md ==========

# Creative Studio

**Route:** `/creative-studio` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/creative-studio)

**When:** Use to generate image/video assets or assemble creative variants.

**Prerequisites:** Approved creative brief, asset rights, exact model variant, credit allowance and output specs.

## Agent procedure

1. Choose Guided or Pro mode and the intended output type.
2. Read current model slug, price, ratio/duration and reference-image requirements.
3. Write the brief and inspect added text/branding fields.
4. Generate once and store the job/generation ID; poll rather than resubmit.
5. Review finished output and saved library asset, then check credit delta.
6. Use Photos → Video, Ad Lab or storyboard only for the matching need and inspect their separate final actions.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The finished asset meets specification, exists in the library and has a verified cost/result.

Model names can repeat with different costs. Avatar/audio labels do not establish available models. Generation was not executed.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

**Route:** `/dashboard` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/dashboard)

**When:** Use to review actual operations and produce evidence-backed reporting.

**Prerequisites:** Correct data sources, dates, timezone, attribution and currency.

## Agent procedure

1. Choose Overview, Analytics, Command Center or Reports.
2. Read empty/disconnected states explicitly and verify underlying sources.
3. Inspect consistent date windows before comparing metrics.

========== runbooks/demand.md ==========

# Demand Map and surge alerts

**Route:** `/demand-map` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/demand-map)

**When:** Use for market research and geographically focused campaign planning.

**Prerequisites:** Approved operating geography, service categories and an interpretable source of demand.

## Agent procedure

1. Enter a specific city/state/region; remove irrelevant default categories.
2. Optionally select the intended saved audience.
3. Generate the map once and inspect location, segments, estimated volumes and assumptions.
4. Drill into a hotspot before creating a campaign; verify target geography in the campaign itself.
5. Enable email surge alerts only under the client’s notification preference.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Map interpretation and resulting campaign geography are reviewed and recorded.

Estimated demand is not a census. The source request supplies descriptive audience context; exact person-level targeting is unverified.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/digest.md ==========

# Weekly Digest

**Route:** `/digest` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/digest)

**When:** Use for a reviewed weekly operating summary.

**Prerequisites:** Verified data and a defined reporting period; permission for email delivery if used.

## Agent procedure

1. Read an existing digest or generate the first.
2. Compare figures with source records and annotate missing data.
3. Review optimization recommendations against approved goals.
4. Preserve the reviewed digest and next actions.
5. Send via Email only if delivery is authorized; verify intended recipient and delivery result.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The summary is accurate and delivered only through the intended channel.

Generate and Send via Email are separate operations; no digest email was sent.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

## Observed controls and fields

1 captured screen states; 3 distinct controls/fields below. These are live UI observations, not a complete backend validation schema. A disabled state is the captured account state, not necessarily a universal restriction.

========== runbooks/intent.md ==========

# High-Intent Buyers and advanced search

**Route:** `/intent` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/intent)

**When:** Use to discover/filter potential buyers and prepare an activation audience.

**Prerequisites:** Approved audience, intended use, geography, topic meaning and lead allowance.

## Agent procedure

1. Choose Business buyers, Consumers or filter-only Advanced search.
2. For intent, search at least three characters and pick up to five relevant topic IDs; avoid irrelevant named-company matches.
3. Apply recency, state/city/ZIP and appropriate B2B or B2C filters.
4. Name the tracker and review its allocation before building; the observed default is large.
5. Record audience ID and poll until complete; inspect counts, sample quality and applied filters.
6. Export or activate only the intended audience, verifying provider match, CRM mapping and delivery authorization.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The returned list matches intended filters and its source/quality are understood.

No audience generation/export or match-rate test was run. Deletion releases quota next cycle. Advanced search is not intent evidence.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/knowledge.md ==========

# Veluro Intelligence and business knowledge

**Route:** `/teach-veluro` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/teach-veluro)

**When:** Use to prepare or update the AI knowledge used across features.

**Prerequisites:** Approved business references and correct isolated account.

## Agent procedure

1. Add the main website and specific useful pages.
2. Upload appropriate supported files within the 30 MB UI limit.
3. Add structured notes using company, competitor, persona, FAQ, pricing or goal categories.
4. Inspect knowledge entries and resolve conflicting facts or stale offers.
5. Ask a bounded factual question and compare the answer with the reference before depending on it.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Knowledge entries exist and output accurately reflects the approved source.

Do not upload passwords, unrelated personal information or another client’s knowledge. Removing an entry changes future AI context.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/landing.md ==========

# Landing pages and A/B tests

**Route:** `/landing-pages` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/landing-pages)

**When:** Use for a single conversion-focused page and controlled variants.

**Prerequisites:** Approved business description, CTA, branding, domain, privacy and page allowance.

## Agent procedure

1. Supply business name, detailed offer and CTA goal.
2. Optionally extract design from an inspiration URL; review design use and write original client copy.
3. Choose look/feel and generate once; preserve page ID.
4. Edit sections, images, form and CTA; preview desktop/mobile output.
5. Publish to the approved slug/domain and verify domain status and served content.
6. For A/B tests, record variant IDs, metric and evaluation window before promoting a winner.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The actual page and conversion destination work, and variant decisions use real data.

Generation, saving, publishing, domain verification and autopilot are separate operations. Page creation is quota-limited.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

# LinkedIn prospecting, Compose and queue

**Route:** `/linkedin` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/linkedin)

**When:** Use for B2B prospect records, manually sent copy and reminder sequences.

**Prerequisites:** Approved prospect context and intended LinkedIn workflow.

## Agent procedure

1. Add the prospect with accurate name/company/profile.
2. Choose Compose and provide role, industry, hook and relevant context.
3. Generate connection request, InMail, follow-up or reply copy.
4. Review and preserve copy; the built-in Compose feature does not send it.
5. Save a sequence to the Outreach Queue when appropriate; mark sent only after actual authorized sending elsewhere.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Prospect records, copy and reminders reflect actual work and message history.

Marketing API connection, identity login and Compose are different capabilities. Do not automate DM delivery by inference.

========== runbooks/partner.md ==========

# Partner dashboard, resellers and payouts

**Route:** `/partner` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/partner)

**When:** Use for referral tracking, recruitment attribution and partner staff operations.

**Prerequisites:** Correct partner account, referral code and agreement.

## Agent procedure

1. Use Overview for referred customers and settled/pending commissions.
2. Use My Team for recruited resellers and Team Members for staff; do not conflate them.
3. Use the appropriate main, trial or reseller invite link and preserve tracking.
4. Use the calculator with 20% direct, 10% reseller subscription and 5% reseller-client revenue bases.
5. Inspect payout/clearing records; verify actual payout separately from projected commission.
6. Prepare staff/income/link changes deliberately and perform them only within scope.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Attribution, commission base, staff relationship and actual payout states are accurately recorded.

Payout/bank changes and invitations require the appropriate authority. No recruitment message or payout action was performed.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

# Pixels and conversion tracking

**Route:** `/pixels` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/pixels)

**When:** Use before measuring or optimizing campaign conversion events.

**Prerequisites:** Authorized site/funnel access and correct provider tag/pixel ID.

## Agent procedure

1. Open Add Pixel and choose Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok or Custom Script.
2. Enter the actual provider identifier/script and a descriptive name.
3. Generate and inspect install code; assign it only to the intended page/funnel.
4. Install through the authorized site flow and trigger a controlled test conversion.
5. Verify the event in the provider and ensure events are not double-fired.

Completion proof: Actual provider event receipt and intended page placement are verified.

# SEO audit and rank tracking

**Route:** `/seo` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/seo)

**When:** Use to diagnose site issues and track approved keywords.

**Prerequisites:** Correct website, site editing authority and relevant keywords/competitors.

## Agent procedure

1. Run a site audit against the intended URL.
2. Inspect findings and proposed fixes; verify issues on the actual pages.
3. Set keywords, competitor and scan preferences deliberately.
4. Apply approved changes in the website system and rerun relevant checks.
5. Compare rank history using the same terms, location and time window.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Actual site changes and tracked observations support the reported improvement.

An audit score or generated fix is not proof of ranking improvement. Repeated scans may consume resources.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/settings.md ==========

# Profile, settings and notifications

**Route:** `/settings` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/settings)

**When:** Use during onboarding, contact changes and preference maintenance.

**Prerequisites:** Correct workspace, approved identity/contact facts and permission to change settings.

## Agent procedure

1. Open Settings → Profile; distinguish login email from public contact email.
2. Fill approved name, business and contact fields and save the profile.
3. Review agent memory against business facts; amend only relevant entries.
4. Open Notifications and set only approved push, reply, demand, win-rate and optimization preferences.
5. Read back changed values and confirm no unintended preference changed.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Saved values survive reload; client-facing materials use the correct public details.

Language selection may save immediately. Reset memory deletes learned context. Auto-Optimize is an operating permission, not just an email preference.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

# Social Media Manager and autopilot

**Route:** `/social` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/social)

**When:** Use to prepare and publish an approved social content calendar.

**Prerequisites:** Correct profiles/pages, brand assets, approved content and schedule/timezone.

## Agent procedure

1. Check each platform connection and current approval gates.
2. Create a manual post or generate a strategy/batch for review.
3. Inspect text, links, hashtags and finished image/video for each platform.
4. Save drafts or approve/schedule within the agreed publishing scope.
5. Verify provider publication and calendar state; reconcile before retrying failures.
6. Configure autopilot only with explicit content, frequency and spending limits.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: Posts appear on the intended profile at the intended time with correct content.

Dragging a post can reschedule it. Autopilot can create and publish content; general Meta approval remains gated.

========== runbooks/storyboard.md ==========

# Storyboard Video Builder

**Route:** `/studio/storyboard` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/studio/storyboard)

**When:** Use for a multi-scene video assembled from a script.

**Prerequisites:** Approved script, duration, aspect ratio, scene plan and credit ceiling.

## Agent procedure

1. Supply the script/brief and select 15/30/45/60 seconds and ratio.
2. Build the storyboard; preserve project and scene IDs.
3. Review script and each scene before generation.
4. Generate required clips, poll their existing IDs and check each result.
5. Stitch only complete approved clips; inspect final video/audio and library output.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The final stitched video matches the approved scene order and technical specification.

Generating scenes and stitching are distinct jobs; partial completion must not trigger duplicate generation.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.

========== runbooks/team.md ==========

# Client workspace team and roles

**Route:** `/team` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/team)

**When:** Use to provision or audit operator access in the client application.

**Prerequisites:** Owner/admin scope and approved person/role.

## Agent procedure

1. Read the actual role matrix and current member list.
2. Choose Owner/Admin/Member according to the required tasks.
3. Prepare the specific invite or role change; verify the exact email/person.
4. Send or save only when member-management authorization covers it.
5. Verify membership status and that only intended permissions changed.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The right operator has the required access in the correct client workspace.

Member cannot run AI agents in the displayed matrix. Only Owner can manage billing/settings. Invites send external messages.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. ========== runbooks/widgets.md ==========

# Website chat widgets

**Route:** `/chat-widgets` · [Open Veluro](https://veluro.ai/chat-widgets)

**When:** Use to answer website questions and capture eligible leads.

**Prerequisites:** Approved bot identity, business knowledge, privacy process, embed access and CRM routing.

## Agent procedure

1. Create a widget with name, welcome, color, goal and tone.
2. Supply business/services/FAQ and optional website/files.
3. Inspect knowledge ingestion; test common questions and unsafe/unknown cases in simulation.
4. Review appearance, lead fields and booking destination.
5. Embed only on the approved site, then verify real capture and CRM routing.

## Success and recovery

Completion proof: The actual embedded widget answers accurately and records leads in the correct account.

Simulation may use AI credits. Widget creation, toggle, duplicate and embed are separate actions.

If loading or a request fails, inspect connection and quota state, then retry safe reads with bounded backoff. Reconcile existing object/job state before any repeated write. Preserve completed work and record the exact unresolved dependency. Consult the central verification register for the feature’s current evidence level.
